recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The source now reflects the applied Device target-profile change without misleading readers into thinking only persons or organizations can be information sources.
issue_request: FHIR-41500 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to add Device to MedicationStatement.informationSource so a system compiling a summary medication statement can be represented as the information source.
initial_application: Git commit 2daabbe269a4d53896cbf62a39f3a025581023e1 applied the core conformance change by adding Device to the MedicationStatement.informationSource target profiles. No prior AutoFHIR Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-41500 was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationStatement as an active resource. Later related Pharmacy history added Group to the same informationSource target list and added a separate MedicationStatement.author element after clarifying that informationSource remains the who/what source of the information, not the author. Pharmacy meeting minutes corroborate the FHIR-41500 7-0-0 approval, and community searches found no conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml so MedicationStatement.informationSource short and definition say "Who or what" provided the information instead of limiting the source to a person or organization. The already-correct target profiles were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: changed MedicationStatement.informationSource short and definition to target-neutral "Who or what" wording.
